name: motion-takayu-error-shake
title: Error Shake
description: Bấm OK với mật khẩu sai, ô nhập rung ngang ±9 px tắt dần trong khoảng nửa giây, viền chuyển màu lỗi và dòng báo lỗi hiện bên dưới.

moworks.author: takayu

options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-error-shake, written here): Password field 140x40 r10 (six dots) with an OK pill. Click at 0.55 s; from 0.65 s x = 9 × e^(−6 t) × sin(44 t) px, faded to 0 between 0.45-0.6 s (always lands at 0). Error border (accent 2 px) and an error line below fade in over 0.63-0.7 s, out at 2.25-2.5 s. Params: at · amp (9 px) · freq (44 rad/s) · decay (6) · duration (0.6 s). x = amp × e^(−decay t) × sin(freq t) from 0.1 s after the click, faded to 0 between 0.45 and 0.6 s, so it always lands at 0.
